question: Find the value of [(18 times 19) timesleft{8 div 4 times ((16-12))/(2)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

[(18 × 19) × {8 ÷ 4 × ((16 - 12) ÷ 2)}]

**Formula used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction).

**Calculation:**

[(18 × 19) × {8 ÷ 4 × ((16 - 12) ÷ 2)}]

⇒ [(18 × 19) × {8 ÷ 4 × (4 ÷ 2)}]

⇒ [(18 × 19) × {8 ÷ 4 × 2}]

⇒ [(18 × 19) × {2 × 2}]

⇒ [(18 × 19) × 4]

⇒ [342 × 4]

⇒ 1368

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
